pluginDesc: Displays EDMCModernOverlay output in Elite Dangerous VR on Linux using an OpenXR layer, with live controls for overlay position, size and curvature.
pluginRequirements: Linux with a working native OpenXR loader and Vulkan VR setup for Elite Dangerous
CMake 3.18+, C++17 compiler, OpenXR and Vulkan development files, and nlohmann-json headers
Flatpak EDMC requires host renderer access via flatpak-spawn --host
